name: Egyptian Codes (ECP 201 loads and seismic, ECP 203 concrete)
description: The Egyptian Code of Practice (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the legacy British Standards pack bs8110: ECP 203 designs concrete on the cube strength fcu with the block 0.67 fcu/γc and γc 1.5, as BS 8110 does, so the concrete methods are the parent's with ECP 203's values (γs 1.15, the block over 0.8 c, c ≤ 2/3 cb, Ec = 4400 √fcu, emin 0.05 t ≥ 20 mm, short columns 0.35 fcu Ac + 0.67 fy As, the shear qcu = 0.24 √(fcu/γc) of which half is counted with stirrups, qmax = 0.7 √(fcu/γc) ≤ 4 MPa). The seismic form of ECP 201-2012 is EN 1998-1's, built here by the generic behaviourFactor spectrum method with ECP 201's values (the zones 1, 2, 3, 4, 5A, 5B with ag 0.10-0.30 g, the soil classes A-D of the two spectrum types, γI 0.8-1.4, R of the systems, the lower bound 0.2 ag γI, λ = 0.85, the drift limits). Load combinations of ECP 203 (1.4D + 1.6L, 0.8(1.4D + 1.6L + 1.6W), 0.9D + 1.3W, 1.12D + αL + E, 0.9D + E). Wind: the parent's BS 6399-2 method with placeholder speeds (ECP 201's wind method is not set). Steel ECP 205 not covered (the parent's BS 5950-1). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' zones, the spectrum types and the R values are uncertain and must be checked before design.
